# W3C XLink schema document

`xlink.xsd` is http://www.w3.org/XML/2008/06/xlink.xsd, unchanged,
fetched 2026-10-20 (9,386 bytes). The W3C XSD test suite's
`common/xsts.xsd` imports it, so the XSD driver (`tests/xsd/driver`)
serves this copy for that URI when it runs the introspection test set
(docs/DECISIONS.md, D278). Nothing that sxml ships reads it. License:
`LICENSE` (W3C Software and Document License).
